CORAM:HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR.
 JUSTICE A.J.DESAI  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIREN VAISHNAV

Date : 06/06/2023  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI)
1. RULE returnable forthwith. Mr.K.M.Antani learned AGP waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of the respondent State.

2. By way of this petition, following main prayers have been made:
"A). This Hon'ble Court be pleased to admit and allow this Special Civil Application.
B).

This Hon'ble Court may be pleased to C/SCA/8881/2023 ORDER DATED:
06/06/2023 hold that impugned action of the respondent no.3, not deciding the application made by the petitioner dated 01/02/2022-11/02/2022 at annexure 'B' is illegal, unjust, arbitrary and against the provisions provided under the Act

and further direct the respondent no.3 to amend the award dated 02/12/2021 at annexure 'A' to the present petition, by calculating interest on aggregate amount of Mafatbhai Ambalal Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38544349/
1 compensation since the amount of compensation is not paid or deposited on or before taking possession of the land, at the rate of nine per cent annum from the 01/01/1980 to 31/12/1981 and thereafter at the rate of fifteen per cent per annum from 01/01/1982 to the till the amount actually paid or deposited as per section 80 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and declare the amended award and pay the amount of compensation to the petitioner as per the said award by way of suitable writ, order or direction under article 226 of the Constitution of India.

entities.text: Mafatbhai Ambalal Patel vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: C). Pending admission, hearing and final disposal of this Special Civil Application.

This Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct the respondent no.3 to decide the application made by the petitioner under section 33 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, at annexure 'B' to the present petition,
within stipulated period and declare the amended award and pay the amount of C/SCA/8881/2023 ORDER DATED: 06/06/2023 compensation as per the said award to the petitioner, in the interest of justice."
3. Having heard learned advocates for the respective parties, we dispose of this petition by the direction to the respondent authority that the respondent authority shall decide an application submitted by the petitioner as early as possible preferably within a period of two months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
